Richard Henry Dana Jr., Two Years Before the Mast.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/richard-henry-dana-jr/two-years-before-the-mast

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Richard Henry Dana Jr., the annotator, died 1882 (Wikidata death date).
- Homer Eaton Keyes, the annotator, died 1938 (Wikidata death date).

First publication of the text used: 1916 (SE colophon: 'Two Years Before the Mast was published in 1916 by Richard Henry Dana Jr').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (the facts do not establish the country of first publication, and the text was first published 1916; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these people. The last person to die, Homer Eaton Keyes, died in 1938, so that term ended on 31 December 2008 at the latest.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
